items.title: Open-weight AI models add new spark to China, Silicon Valley's AI race
items.summary: Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Ines Ferré and Breaking News Reporter Jake Conley to assess and discuss the rising competition between open-weight AI models from China — which are public to download and modify — and Silicon Valley's top artificial intelligence developers.

items.title: BYD Sets Export Record. Nio, XPeng, and Li Auto Stocks Suffer
items.summary: Chinese EV leader  BYD  delivered strong July sales, sending its shares higher in overseas trading.  In China, BYD sold about 239,000 vehicles, including commercial vehicles, down 22% year over year.  BYD shares were up 0.8% in overseas trading on Monday, leaving shares down less than 1% this year.

items.title: Tesla Stock Rises Despite 1.2 Million-Vehicle Safety Probe
items.summary: Tesla extended its recovery as investors looked beyond a federal investigation involving Model 3 and Model Y suspension failures.

items.title: A SpaceX Earnings Preview: Starlink Growth, AI Costs, Starship Roadmap
items.summary: SpaceX releases its first public quarterly report next week. Shares fall as Elon Musk's rocket company grapples with rising costs.

items.title: Tesla Stock Goes for 3 Gains in a Row as It Shrugs Off Safety Inquiry
items.summary: Tesla  stock rose Monday, making it three gains in a row after a brutal stretch following the company’s second-quarter earnings report.  Weaker-than-expected second-quarter earnings reported on July 22 contributed to a six-day losing streak, sending Tesla stock down more than 20%.  NHTSA recently opened an investigation into more than a million Tesla vehicles for a potential suspension issue.
